_about: Who each phone number reaches. First judged 2026-10-21 from Hunter's names/roles (Matthew: 'prioritize the ones that lead to a good person'), then re-checked the same day against each company's own newsroom, media or contact page (Matthew: 'do it for all the companies, so that we can get the most accurate numbers'). tier 1 = direct line to a person or team who could handle a sponsorship; 2 = main line at a small organisation, likely the decision-maker; 3 = a big company's front desk: ask for the person by name; 4 = no good number (email first, or not found). 'src' = where the number and names came from. 'people' = contacts confirmed on that source, listed ahead of Hunter's: [name, role, email, phone]. Hunter's phones that no company page confirms say so in src.

UCHealth (Memorial Hospital; Memorial No.how: Direct to Cary Vogrin, UCHealth's Southern Colorado communications Region Manager (a Memorial number). Sponsorship requests go to Brand@uchealth.org

Alpine Bank.how: Direct to Alan Sandberg, Director of Marketing (head office). Colorado Springs branch: 719-421-7600
Alpine Bank.src: Alpine Bank press releases, 31 Oct 2024 and 14 Jan 2025 (blog.alpinebank.com); 2026 releases name only the CFO, so confirm he is still there

Coca-Cola.how: Direct to Michele McKillip, Swire Coca-Cola's head of public relations (corporate affairs often handles sponsorships). Colorado Springs distribution center: 719-257-5745

Ent Credit Union.how: Ent's local media line (its communications team); ask who handles community sponsorships. Written requests go to the Community Impact Team, communityadvocacy@ent.com. Ent's giving rules exclude individual sports teams unless it is a direct sponsorship, so pitch it as one
Ent Credit Union.src: https://www.ent.com/pressreleases/ ('Please direct all media inquiries to MediaContact@ent.com or (719) 747-6619') and https://www.ent.com/Community

BOK Financial.how: Direct to Lorie Rubio, BOK Financial's Colorado media contact; ask who handles community sponsorships (Gilbert Gerst, SVP Community Development, by email)

T. Rowe Price.how: Direct to Arminta Plater, Corporate PR (her listed areas include community partnerships and grants). Not local: Colorado Springs is T. Rowe's second-largest US office, so lead with that. Campus switchboard: 719-278-5600

The Gazette.how: Direct to Karen Hogan, Director of Advertising Operations/Events. Pitch a tournament or event partnership (a media trade), not an ad buy

Dwire Earthmoving, LLC.how: Direct to Jeff Dwire, owner. Office: 719-574-7123

McLane Company.how: Direct to Tom Sicola, VP of Marketing (Texas head office). Alternative: Alicia Downard, Director of Communications and PR, by email
McLane Company.src: Tom Sicola's number is from Hunter (no McLane page shows it); Alicia Downard from McLane's April 2025 Business Wire release

Republic Services.how: Direct to Jennifer Eldridge, Marketing Director (Phoenix head office). Company media line: 480-757-9770
Republic Services.src: Jennifer Eldridge's number is from Hunter; the media line and Media@RepublicServices.com are from Republic's June 2023 release on buying GFL's Colorado operations

Colorado Springs Chamber & EDC.how: Main line; small staff. Ask who handles events and member partnerships

Hispanic Chamber of Commerce.how: Main line, which is also Joe Aldaz's (President & CEO). Email info@cshispanicchamber.com

Colorado Media Group.how: Main line (North magazine); ask for Dirk Hobbs, Division Manager. Pitch a media trade, not a cash buy

Cumulus Media.how: Colorado Springs stations' office. Ask for Kathi Page, General Sales Manager, about a media trade (their airtime for Peak exposure). Jay Davis, Regional VP, took over the six Colorado Springs stations in June 2026
Cumulus Media.src: Main line from BBB and station listings (the stations' own page lists direct lines on the same 593-27xx block); Kathi Page from https://www.kvor.com/station-information; Jay Davis from Cumulus's 23 June 2026 release
people: General Sales Manager, Cumulus Colorado Springs

Altitude Movement.how: Main line; small gym, ask for the owner. Its website is down, so check the number still works
Altitude Movement.src: Macaroni Kid Colorado Springs directory (altitudemovement.com returns 'site not found')

Southern Colorado Women’s Chamber of Com.how: Main line; small staff. Ask for Lola Woloch; pitch a member mixer at Peak

Neon Pig.how: Main line. Neon Pig is a downtown creative agency (design, web, advertising), not a restaurant; ask for the owner
Neon Pig.src: https://neonpigcreative.com/ (the Sports Corp member list links there)

Windstar Studios.how: Main line; video and social production studio. Ask for Elizabeth Grzelak

Mind Quest Puzzles and Games.how: The Palmer Lake store; ask for an owner (Karen Wells or Jessica Bradley). They run puzzle events, so a joint family event fits
Mind Quest Puzzles and Games.src: Phone from Our Community News event listings; email from mindquestpuzzles.com; owners from a Gazette story on the opening

Molson Coors.how: Head office front desk: ask for Meghan Means, Marketing Director, or the Golden brewery's community affairs team
Molson Coors.src: Phone from an SEC filing; the community affairs manager's name differs between sources, none dated, so it's left out

Cheyenne Mountain Resort.how: Front desk: ask for Jess Johnson, Director of Sales and Marketing (check first whether they run their own pickleball courts)
Cheyenne Mountain Resort.src: Phone from hotel listings; Jess Johnson quoted in Hyatt's 15 Oct 2024 release on the resort joining Destination by Hyatt

Laborjack.how: Fort Collins office: ask for Jon Emerick, VP of Strategic Alliances. Company line: 833-527-1185 (support)
Laborjack.src: Fort Collins number from moving-company listings; support line from https://www.laborjack.com/contact

OrangeTheory.how: Stetson Hills studio front desk: ask for the studio manager or the franchise owner (local studios are franchised; corporate won't sponsor a local club)
OrangeTheory.src: Wellhub's listing for the Stetson Hills studio; the same number was in the studio's 2013 opening release

Kaiser Permanente.how: No phone for sponsorships: email communityco@kp.org (Kaiser's Colorado community sponsorship inbox; its rules exclude advertising)
Kaiser Permanente.src: Kaiser's sponsorship page; no Colorado media contact could be confirmed on a Kaiser page

Chord Energy.how: Houston head office; no community contact named. Its Colorado link is its COO, Darrin Henke, on the Colorado Chamber board; most of its operations are in North Dakota
Chord Energy.src: https://www.chordenergy.com/contact; the Colorado Chamber's board-member feature (Sept 2025)

Climax Molybdenum.how: No good number (Freeport's 877-629-2609 is a general community information and grievance line). Email Nell Wareham, Strategic Community Development Manager at Climax, or communitydevelopment@fmi.com
people: Strategic Community Development Manager, Climax Mine (2021 notes)

PCL Construction.how: No good number (no Denver line is published; the one found is a labour-relations director in Toronto). Email Alison Tucker, VP of Marketing

Progressive.how: No public phone. Email media_leads@progressive.com, which Progressive lists for media and sponsorship opportunities

USAA.how: No good number: USAA's media line (210-498-0940) is for reporters only. Email Jennifer Escobar, VP of Brand Marketing

Concept Restaurants.how: Only a restaurant front desk (MacKenzie's Chop House). Email Erin Copeland, VP of Marketing, first
Concept Restaurants.src: Restaurant listings; a 635-8190 number for 'Concept Restaurants, Inc.' could not be confirmed, so it isn't used

iHeart Media.how: National ad sales line (sells ads). Ask for the Colorado Springs market president, Samantha Kumm (named 2018), and pitch a media trade
iHeart Media.src: https://www.iheartmedia.com/advertising; no local iHeart office number found

KEG1.src: https://www.keg1llc.site/ (linked from the Sports Corp member list)

Randy R Kilgore & Company.how: Not found online. Ask the Sports Corp for an introduction
